Sara will also share a practical approach to identifying these risks and translating responsible AI principles into clearer product, design, and governance decisions. **Bio:** Sara is a behavioural scientist and responsible AI practitioner with 17+ years of experience across product, UX, and research in global technology companies including Shopify, Expedia, F-Secure, and Unit4. From simple things like being early to welcome people, through to PR and graphic design and a website. Let us know if that sounds like you and apply to join the team [here](https://forms.gle/EeLboZcYBrLesVt26) Newcomers are especially welcome, and if you’re feeling shy, don't worry. you’re free to listen or join in at your own pace. Bring your ideas, your curiosity, and your favourite conversation starters. Share your LinkedIn or project links with the group, and let’s help each other grow—personally and professionally. This evening is about making connections that matter, all in a friendly, inclusive setting. If you’d like to help shape future gatherings or feature in our community newsletter, let us know. Come for the connections, stay for the camaraderie!
